user.title: Bticino Classe 100X
user.description: The address of the intercom on your network. Your router's device list shows it; the name usually starts with BTICINO.

data_description.topic: What the intercom publishes under. Leave it as it is unless you changed it when building the firmware.

error.cannot_connect: Nothing answered at that address. Check the intercom is on your network and has been flashed.

abort.already_configured: That intercom is already set up.

pick_up.name: Pick up
pick_up.description: Answers the call and shows the door.

hang_up.name: Hang up
hang_up.description: Ends the call by disconnecting from the video.

look.name: Look
look.description: Turns the door camera on, or off again.

capture_photo.name: Take a photo
capture_photo.description: Grabs one frame of the door.

video_on_screen.name: Report the video
video_on_screen.description: Used by the card to say whether a picture has arrived.

microphone_state.name: Report the microphone
microphone_state.description: Used by the card to say what the microphone is doing.
